question.text: A mixture of chlorides of copper, cadmium, chromium, iron and aluminium was dissolved in water acidified with $\mathrm{HCl}$ and hydrogen sulphide gas was passed for sufficient time. It was filtered, boiled and a few drops of nitric acid were added while boiling. To this solution ammonium chloride and sodium hydroxide were added and filtered. The filterate shall give test for.

solution.text: CuS and CdS are precipitated by $\mathrm{H}_{2} \mathrm{~S}$. Hydroxide of Al will pass into the solution in the form of $\mathrm{NaAlO}_{2}$ being amphoteric in nature. Hence filtrate will give test for sodium and aluminium.
